title: Form 1120 — Keystone Corp.
instructions: Keystone Corp. reports 2025 book net income of **$800,000**. Compute taxable income and tax.

exhibits.title: Items included in book net income
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Federal income tax expense | 200,000 |
| Municipal bond interest | 20,000 |
| Dividends from a 10%-owned domestic corporation | 40,000 |
| Premiums on key-person life insurance (Keystone is beneficiary) | 6,000 |
| Fines | 4,000 |
| Business meals | 14,000 |
| Charitable contributions (cash) | 60,000 |
| Book depreciation | 100,000 |

exhibits.title: Other
exhibits.content: Tax depreciation is **$150,000**. There are no carryovers.

rows.label: Taxable income before charitable contributions and DRD
